_source: CWaPE ANNEXE 7 - societes et associations, format of 2026-02-06. The regulator's own fillable PDF; only field values are set.
_scope: Only the fields OptimCE can derive, or that a reviewer routinely fills, are mapped. Everything else is left untouched and the artifact stays a fillable AcroForm, so an unmapped field remains editable by hand rather than being lost.
_scope_extra: Per-entity: the reviewer chooses which member this annex is for, so the identity fields are supplied in the review step rather than derived.
